complaints.description: We are logging a formal complaint regarding a recent shipment we received through our distributor, Apex Pharma Logistics. During our routine inward quality check today, our warehouse team found severe issues with the Azithromycin Tablets, 500mg. The affected batch number is AZI-2604-B12. According to the labels, the manufacturing date is 15-04-2026, and the expiry date is 14-04-2029. Out of the total delivery, we have segregated 200 boxes that are directly affected. We are classifying this complaint type as "Discoloration and Broken Tablets." Specifically, we noticed yellowish spotting on the surface of the tablets and several chipped pieces inside the fully sealed blister packs. We suspect there may have been a moisture seal failure during packaging. Please log this in your system, initiate an urgent investigation, and advise us on the return and replacement protocol as soon as possible. Best regards, Sarah Jenkins Quality Supervisor Apollo Pharmacy
complaints.suggestedNextAction: Route to QA Investigation & Issue Replacement
complaints.initialRiskAssessment: The discoloration and broken tablets likely stem from moisture seal failure during packaging, leading to tablet degradation and physical damage.
